info.title: FileFn Client Contract
info.description: Deterministic OpenAPI contract for the FileFn HTTP surface supported by the Swift client.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of files to return

XRequestID.name: x-request-id
XRequestID.description: Opaque request correlation ID forwarded through FileFn envelopes.

XFileFnClientVersion.name: x-filefn-client-version
XFileFnClientVersion.description: Optional client version header emitted by FileFn clients.

Authorization.name: Authorization
Authorization.description: Bearer or custom authorization header resolved by the host app.

XIdempotencyKey.name: x-idempotency-key
XIdempotencyKey.description: Optional idempotency key used for upload initialization.

XUploadSessionToken.name: x-upload-session-token
XUploadSessionToken.description: Anonymous upload-session token required by protected upload routes.
